error_reason: The Planner committed a fundamental conceptual error by conflating the microscopic origin of interatomic forces (electromagnetic) with the macroscopic classification of the wave phenomenon (mechanical longitudinal). This error occurred in the first verification step without any external fact-checking or alternative reasoning to catch the contradiction between the 'discrete bodies' premise and standard physics definitions of sound/compression waves in solids.

hypotheses.rationale: The Planner incorrectly classified the propagation of force through touching solid spheres as an electromagnetic wave. While the interatomic forces are electromagnetic in nature, the macroscopic disturbance (compression and expansion of the balls) is defined by physics textbooks as a mechanical longitudinal wave. This fundamental conceptual error led directly to the wrong final answer without any external verification or alternative reasoning.
